top6_grace.length_note: Grace spell length is the full span, first season to last inclusive, so a one-season dip inside the spell counts toward its length (and toward length_distribution, persistent_contenders and the 13-season cap). in_window_seasons on each spell counts only the seasons actually in the window; those sum to in_window_club_seasons.

patterns.definition: Readings at threshold k: Opening Day od_rank, deadline pd_rank, and the same club's od_rank the following season; above means rank <= k. 2026 rows get partial labels and are excluded from 2014-2025 counts.

sequences.note: Clubs with labels from the set in two or more consecutive seasons, 2014-2025 (2026 partial labels excluded). Null: labels shuffled across clubs within each season, 10000 times, seed 20261024; p95 uses linear interpolation.

backcast.source: Baseball-Reference preseason playoff odds (earliest row per club-season)
